_comment: Starter permission policy, seeded once into
Tier 1 (this file): reversible, everyday actions, reachable only through
the argv-validating wrappers in bin/. No general-purpose launcher
(uwsm-app, hyprctl dispatch exec, xdg-open) and no bare `omarchy` are
pre-approved, because any one of them makes every other rule here
Tier 2: anything else the agent needs is requested with
bin/request-grant.sh and approved by the user on a card in the panel.
Tier 3: disruptive or irreversible actions call bin/confirm.sh and block
on a per-invocation yes. Approving once grants nothing for next time.
The browser is pre-approved for READING only. Acting on a page —
navigating, clicking, typing, uploading, running script — is tier 3,
enforced by bin/chrome-gate.sh as a PreToolUse hook rather than by a
rule here, because a page the agent reads can tell it what to do next.
